name: MRF Limited
remarksWeb: 1319 shares lying in the account of Ms. Anna Thomas Chacko, Executor of the will of Late Ms. Susy Thomas, has been transferred to the beneficiary of the will i.e., Ms. Tara Thomas Chacko during this quarter ended 31.12.2025.   Consequently, the shares lying in the account of the executor Ms. Anna Thomas Chacko, Executor of the will of Late Ms. Susy Thomas has become NIL and a new member Ms. Tara Thomas Chacko, has been added to the promoter group for the quarter ended 31.12.2025 in the Individuals Non-Resident category.
